newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Allied Grp plans to lift prop'ty arm stake.
newsitem.headline: Allied Grp plans to lift prop'ty arm stake.

text.p: Allied Group Ltd said on Monday it plans to lift its stake in Allied Properties (Hong Kong) Ltd to 50.29 percent from 49.88 percent by buying 10 million additional Allied Properties shares on the open market.

After the completion of the acquisition, which was subject to shareholder approval, Allied Properties would be re-classified as a subsidairy of Allied Group and will enhance the net aset value of the company, it said in a statement.
The consideration estimated at HK$14.6 million based on the closing price of HK$1.46 per Allied Properties share on Friday would be financed through the company's internal resources.
Allied Group said it planned to buy the Allied Properties shares on the open market from independent shareholders in cash on or before December 31, 1997.
The book value of the net tangible assets of Allied Properties was HK$5.73 billion taking into account the interim results for the six months ended at June 30, 1996, it added.
